explanation: 70/30 stratified split on binary component label (i.i.d. data, no temporal ordering). GMM (2 components, full covariance) preserves bimodal marginal structure and per-cluster correlations; the single Gaussian baseline collapses to one ellipsoid. KS p-value mean (higher=better) and correlation MAE (lower=better) compare synthetic vs held-out real test marginals/correlations. KNN accuracy (higher=better) measures whether cluster separability survives generation.
